data.exact_reserve_text:
Material over provisions for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior accident years' claims are as follows:

Marine and aviation 3,467 (1,415)
Non-marine property (612) (7,821)
Property treaty 1,767 4,293
Speciality lines (4,450) 4,533
Release/(strengthening) 172 (410)
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a small net favourable prior-year development on claims of GBP 0.172m (gross release). Movements were mixed across classes with releases in Marine & Aviation and Property Treaty partially offset by adverse development in Speciality Lines (resulting in an overall small release). The amount is taken from the note showing material over/under provisions for prior accident years; the note's phrasing suggests it may be presented relative to payments/provisions and there is some ambiguity whether the line is gross or net of reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: Material over provisions for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior accident years' claims are as follows:
This increase was driven primarily by higher attritional and large loss experience. In particular, there were several significant claims emanating from the Marine and Aviation books of business.
no significant losses arising from catastrophes during 2014

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount derived from Note 4 ('Material over provisions...') which presents per-line figures; the note's wording references 'net payments and provisions' leading to ambiguity whether the table figures are gross (insurance liabilities) or net of reinsurance. The extraction treats the table as gross for the purposes of the prior_year_development_gbp_m field but confidence is reduced. No claims development triangle was found in the provided pages. Line-of-business mapping for 'Speciality lines' to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate.
